problem_restatement: Screen 2 must display current v51 provider evaluations, routed and withheld outcomes, and live exposure without material checkpoint lag or mixed accounting scopes.

diagnosis.observed_failure: The running checkpoint worker repeatedly rejected the compatible execution-history cache because it compared the v51 accounting-epoch archive count with the broader all-time-live reflection count.
diagnosis.pre_fix_effect: Every refresh fell back to rebuilding approximately 1.35 GB of cohort history plus asset ledgers, causing observed Screen 2 checkpoint lag from approximately 60 seconds to at least 158 seconds and multi-gigabyte worker memory use.
diagnosis.screen_two_rendering_assessment: The current TUI renderer displayed the routed HYPE action, seven setup rows, and the live HYPE position when supplied a refreshed checkpoint. The missing-data symptom was upstream checkpoint latency, not a Screen 2 row-rendering omission.
diagnosis.root_cause_falsifier: A deployed patched worker that still rejects the real compatible suffix, rebuilds the full projection each cycle, or leaves Screen 2 materially stale would falsify the diagnosis.

validated_fix.behavior: When the archive declares an accounting epoch, compare the bounded epoch archive only with the complete archive for that same epoch; preserve the legacy broad-history comparison when no epoch is declared.
verification: The new regression failed before the implementation with the exact archive/reflection count mismatch.
The focused checkpoint suite passed 54 tests after implementation.
Ruff check and Ruff format check passed.
A production-data probe selected the compatible suffix in 4.857 seconds and retained the open HYPE lifecycle.

monitoring_limitations: The unrealized value is not realized profit and excludes the future exit fee and exit slippage.
One entry is insufficient to update the strategy's slippage distribution.
The lifecycle must finish under its frozen exit contract before exit quality can be assessed.

change_proposal.Recommendation: Deploy only the accounting-epoch-aware checkpoint cache fix at the next verified flat and owned-order-free restart boundary, then rerun the all-screen live acceptance checks.
change_proposal.Why now: Screen 2 currently receives truthful but materially delayed data, and the unnecessary full-history rebuild consumes substantial CPU, memory, and disk I/O.
change_proposal.Evidence reviewed: Current v51 checkpoint and ledgers, process table, exact Screen 2 render regressions, the pre-fix production failure, the post-fix real-data compatible-suffix probe, and 54 focused checkpoint tests.
change_proposal.Observed problem/opportunity: Mixed accounting scopes invalidated a valid cache and delayed cockpit telemetry; the bounded epoch comparison restores fast, scope-correct checkpoint generation.
change_proposal.Applicable market regime: Regime independent; this is an observability and accounting-scope correction.
change_proposal.Alternatives considered: Leave the lag in place, hot-reload or kill the worker during an open trade, or hide broad all-time history. Leaving it unfixed is operationally weak; restarting while open is unsafe; hiding history would remove valid evidence.
change_proposal.Proposed live change: Restart the unchanged v51 profile with the patched checkpoint code only after HYPE is flat and every cohort-owned order is absent. No strategy, route, asset, sizing, leverage, stop, target, or exit parameter changes.
change_proposal.Expected upside: Restore bounded checkpoint refreshes, reduce memory and I/O pressure, and make Screen 2 reflect new actions and positions within the configured checkpoint cadence rather than one to more than two-and-a-half minutes late.
change_proposal.Main risks/failure modes: Incorrect epoch matching could omit valid history; a careless restart could orphan an open lifecycle; low disk headroom could still interrupt telemetry writes even after the cache fix.
change_proposal.Validation completed: Red-to-green unit regression, 54 focused tests, Ruff and diff checks, real-data suffix probe, and current-binary Screen 2 rendering with the routed HYPE action.
change_proposal.Validation still required: Flat/order-free preflight, normal backend stop, fresh backup, patched restart, two successive bounded checkpoint refreshes, exact current/all-time reconciliation, all-nine-screen TUI acceptance, and a no-fault poststart window.
change_proposal.Success metrics: Checkpoint refresh completes without full-projection fallback, compatible cohort bytes remain bounded near the verified suffix, Screen 2 shows the latest routed/withheld/open state within the configured cadence, and accounting-epoch plus all-time counts remain separately correct.
change_proposal.Failure/rollback triggers: Any history omission, count/PnL mismatch, full-projection fallback, checkpoint age above 90 seconds, process fault, identity mismatch, or missing Screen 2 action/position data requires a normal flat-boundary rollback to the preserved prestart backup.
change_proposal.Confidence level: High confidence in the diagnosed cache mismatch and code-level correction; medium confidence in deployed cadence until a flat-boundary restart and live acceptance prove it under the running workload.
change_proposal.Explicit approval requested: Not yet. Request deployment only when the active HYPE lifecycle is closed and all owned orders are absent.

highest_value_next_investigation.selection: Complete and reconcile the active HYPE lifecycle under its frozen v51 exit contract.
highest_value_next_investigation.reason: It is the only current capital exposure and provides immediate exact evidence about regime-supported extension, stop protection, profit retention, fees, funding, and exit slippage.
highest_value_next_investigation.parallel_observation: Continue exact source-native SP500 and SPCX lifecycle capture without changing their v51 parameters.
highest_value_next_investigation.update_condition: After HYPE closes, compare realized lifecycle economics with the entry state and frozen exit plan, then reassess whether an exit hypothesis is warranted.
